claude.sample_unit: pipeline-flagged documentation items (565 adjudications by 10 clinicians)

links.outcome: Validity of automated judges detecting scribe note errors versus blinded clinician adjudication
links.effect: Judge-clinician agreement 64% (95% CI 60 to 68); inter-clinician AC1 0.24; concordance on 77 consensus items 70% (95% CI 59 to 79); genuine-error rate among flagged 68% (94% CrI 48 to 83).
links.quote: On 77 consensus items the pipeline concurred on 70% (95% CI 59 to 79).

links.outcome: Independent external clinician review of automated error-detection pipeline flags, blinded to authorship
links.effect: Ten external clinicians adjudicated 434 flags; inter-clinician agreement fair (raw 59%, AC1 0.24), so no human consensus served as truth; judge agreement 64% overlapped clinician agreement.
links.quote: Inter-clinician agreement on genuineness was fair (raw 59%, 95% CI 50 to 67; AC1 0.24), leaving no human consensus to serve as truth.
